ACTL.description: Analysis Control (ACTL). Single global model setting stored under key "1"; all fields are model-wide analysis flags plus the equilibrium iteration count and truss convergence tolerance.

ARDC.description: Auto Rotational DOF Constraint. When true, automatically constrains rotational DOFs for elements with no rotational stiffness (Truss / Plane Stress / Solid).

ANRC.description: Auto Normal Rotation Constraint. When true, automatically constrains the drilling (normal) rotation DOF for plate elements.

CSECF.description: Consider Section Stiffness Scale Factor for stress calculation.

TRS.description: Transfer Reactions of slave node to the master node.

BMSTRESS.description: Calculate Equivalent Beam Stresses (Von-Mises and Max-Shear).

CRBAR.description: Consider Reinforcement for section stiffness calculation.

CLATS.description: Change Local Axis of Tapered Section for force / stress calculation.

ITER.description: Number of iterations per load case for equilibrium (nonlinear/iterative) solution.
